description: This is an abstract PHP class defining the common functionality for OAuth2. service providers within the league/oauth2-client library, including methods for authorization URL generation, token handling, request creation, and response parsing.

classes.name: AbstractProvider
classes.description: An abstract base class for OAuth2 providers, encapsulating common functionalities such as authorization URL generation, token exchange, resource owner fetching, request handling, and response parsing. It employs traits for array access, property guarding, and query building, and defines abstract methods that subclasses must implement for provider-specific endpoints and resource owner creation.

methods.name: getBaseAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Abstract method to return the provider-specific URL for authorization.

methods.name: getBaseAccessTokenUrl
methods.description: Abstract method to return the provider-specific URL for access token requests.

methods.name: getResourceOwnerDetailsUrl
methods.description: Abstract method to return the URL for fetching resource owner details.

methods.name: getDefaultScopes
methods.description: Abstract method to specify default OAuth2 scopes for the provider.

methods.name: createResourceOwner
methods.description: Abstract method to instantiate a resource owner object from response data and access token.

methods.name: checkResponse
methods.description: Abstract method to verify the provider's response for errors.
